explication: Windmill is a self-hostable developer platform for turning scripts into runnable interfaces, composing scripts into workflows, and exposing them through apps, APIs, and event triggers. A typical path starts with a developer or operator creating a script, then a user or trigger starts a run; the backend queues work for a worker, which executes it and returns a result. The README documents additional app, flow, scheduling, and integration capabilities. The graph uses those documented relationships and tree-supported paths; source excerpts are partial and do not establish every internal call.
